# Rouge Care

> > Rouge Care manufactures professional-grade red light therapy and near-infrared LED devices for full-body wellness, muscle recovery, and anti-aging skin treatments.

Rouge Care specializes in advanced photobiomodulation devices including the G4 Series panels, therapy beds, and face masks with smart controls and customizable light wavelengths. The site provides comprehensive product information, scientific education, customer reviews, and clinical support resources.

## Key Topics

- Red Light Therapy
- Photobiomodulation
- Rouge G4 Series
- LED Light Therapy
- Near-Infrared (NIR)
- Full-Body Treatment
- Muscle Recovery
- Anti-Aging Skin Care
- Smart Control
- Light Wavelengths
- Wellness Devices
- Rouge Ultimate G4
- Rouge Max G4
- Bluetooth Controls
- Light Therapy Protocols

- [Rouge Max G4](https://rouge.care/collections/rouge-g4-panels/products/rouge-max-g4-bundle): Product page for Rouge Max G4 full-body panel with 576 LEDs and smart controls
